name: Ilthalaine
summary: Ilthalaine is a night elf guardian standing watch over the sacred glade of Shadowglen in Teldrassil. He serves as the primary greeter and mentor for young night elves taking their very first steps into the world. Vigilant and attuned to the wilderness, he guides novice adventurers toward maintaining the delicate balance of nature across the boughs of the World Tree.

sections.title: Guardian of the Glen
sections.body: Positioned just outside the heart of Shadowglen, Ilthalaine is often the first face a fledgling night elf sees upon beginning their journey. He observes the woodland paths and notices the subtle shifts within the forest that go unseen by ordinary eyes. His duty is to welcome returning kin and ensure that any newly awakened defenders are grounded in the traditions of their people, ready to face the responsibilities that come with tending to Teldrassil.

sections.title: The Balance of Nature
sections.body: Even in the sheltered canopy of Shadowglen, unnatural aggression stirs among the local beasts. Ilthalaine tasks young defenders with hunting stray nightsabers and boars whose growing numbers and viciousness threaten to upend the harmony of the bough. He views culling not as cruelty, but as a vital sacred duty to preserve life and curb the uncharacteristic unrest that has begun to seep into the new World Tree.

sections.title: A Guide to Discipline
sections.body: Beyond testing an adventurer's martial prowess against corrupted wildlife, Ilthalaine directs young elves toward their chosen callings. Entrusting each traveler with a class sigil, he points them directly to their mentors within the Aldrassil sanctuary—whether they follow the path of the warrior, druid, rogue, priest, or hunter. Through him, every novice learns where their service to the Kaldorei begins.

faq.answer: Ilthalaine is a Kaldorei overseer located in Shadowglen, the sheltered starting bower of Teldrassil. He serves as the first quest giver for newly created night elf adventurers, introducing them to their duties and the state of the forest.

faq.q: What is Ilthalaine's role in Shadowglen?
faq.answer: He watches over the wildlife in Shadowglen and ensures new night elves understand the importance of nature's equilibrium. He sends young initiates on basic hunts and directs them to their respective class trainers inside the great tree of Aldrassil.

faq.q: Why does Ilthalaine want the young nightsabers and boars culled?
faq.answer: The woodland creatures of Shadowglen have grown unusually fierce and aggressive, upsetting the natural harmony of the forest. Ilthalaine directs young champions to cull their overpopulated ranks to restore order to the bough.

faq.q: What are the sigils he gives out?
faq.answer: Ilthalaine gives class-specific inscribed sigils to novices, instructing them to seek out their trainers—such as priestesses, druids, warriors, and rogues—sheltered within the roots of Aldrassil.
He stands right on the central path of Shadowglen, just south of the massive hollow bough of Aldrassil in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Is Ilthalaine affiliated with the druids or the sentinels?
faq.answer: Ilthalaine acts as a general caretaker and representative of the Kaldorei in Shadowglen. While deeply attuned to nature and the druidic ethos of harmony, he works on behalf of all Darnassian leadership to guide novices of every discipline.

angles.text: Ilthalaine is the first mentor every young night elf encounters, offering foundational wisdom about stewardship and the sacred balance of their newfound home on Teldrassil.
For budding druids, Ilthalaine's teachings on culling and natural equilibrium provide their very first practical lessons in Cenarion principles.
He represents the calm, enduring vigilance of the Kaldorei, welcoming new champions into the service of Darnassus and the broader Alliance.
